name: Tailliuir Rules
description: ⚠️ READ THIS IMPORTANT INFORMATION BEFORE USING: 🔴 FIRST: ALWAYS USE THE TAILLIUIR NETWORK STREAMS FIRST. 🔴 SECOND: NOTICE THE STREAM COLORS—THE STREAMS ARE TRAFFIC LIGHT COLOURED (GREEN, AMBER, RED) TO SHOW CURRENT SPEED AND RELIABILITY. 🔴 THIRD: IF TAILLIUIR STREAMS ARE BUSY, ONLY THEN USE ANY OTHER OF THE ADDONS AVAILABLE IN THE LIST. 🔴 FOURTH: CRITICAL WARNING—DO NOT CLICK OR SELECT 4K STREAMS IF YOUR STREAMING DEVICE IS NOT 4K COMPATIBLE, AS THEY WILL ABSOLUTELY NOT WORK ON YOUR SCREEN!
